metadata.title: 药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法 (Provisions for Adverse Drug Reaction Reporting and Monitoring, 2011; cited as MOH Order No. 81)
metadata.edition: 2011 Provisions, in force 1 July 2011 (Art. 67) · Arts. 3, 19 to 22, 24, 27, 33 and 67 · order number not shown on the fetched page; no repeal found as of 2026-11-11
metadata.legal_basis: Provisions for ADR Reporting and Monitoring (2011) · departmental rule; the GVP applies where they differ (GVP Q&A (1)); the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
